From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Naomi / Marissa — forwarding Sara’s ask and your draft. I pulled a quick internal alignment with engineering and put suggested owners/dates inline in the MAP (see notes column). Highlights / changes I recommend:

1) Security path — make security evidence delivery a Redwood-owned deliverable by 10/29 (we have a team ready) rather than waiting for a procurement ping. That shortens the loop.

2) Sandbox window — propose we provision a short-lived sandbox (API key + restricted dataset) by 11/02 so EdgeGrid can begin smoke tests earlier. We can expand scope after initial validation.

3) Integration validation — split into: (a) auth/connectivity tests (2 days), (b) sample prompt regression (1 week). Recommend dates: auth tests 11/03–11/04; sample prompts 11/05–11/12.

4) Performance tuning — move earlier to 11/20–11/27 to give the team time to iterate before acceptance window.

5) Acceptance & rollback plan — add a go/no-go checkpoint on 12/09; if critical regressions are found, we slip by two weeks and fall back to the staged rollout.

RACI (suggested):
- Redwood Solutions: Responsible for sandbox + perf tuning (Ben)
- Customer Success: Accountable for acceptance criteria & cutover decisions (Marissa)
- Customer (EdgeGrid): Consulted during validation; Responsible for signoff (Sara / Platform lead)
- Naomi: Informed and owner of commercial/pricing/procurement deadlines

I’ll slot time for a technical kickoff with the EdgeGrid platform lead once they confirm a name — suggest 30–45m the week of 10/25.

Attachment: internal_notes_EDGE-MAP-v0.1.xlsx (inline comments)

-ben
